criteria.observation: Reader and writer choices keep currently active versions compatible with the mixed records, supported by observed reader values.
The transition preserves newer legacy and dual writes through verified backfill and retirement.
Every checkpoint gates cutover on evidence of current complete values and drained legacy writers without adding unsupported holds.
Recovery decisions use the existing schema, snapshot and later writes to preserve current values. Missing write evidence remains unresolved.
The trace links the plan’s judgments to reader values, checkpoint facts, missing evidence and the distinct authorizations and revalidation needed before an effect.
